notes.title: Surprise! Assemble With Care is now on Android!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36430131/d8174f0268c3373f99b504832957e058e20d63ee.gif[/img]

[h3][b]We're incredibly excited to announce that Assemble With Care is going to be playable and available for more players than ever before, launching on Android devices for the very first time! 🎉[/b][/h3]

With this new release, the game is available entirely [i][b]free to start[/b][/i] - so if you're a big fan of Assemble on Steam, but have never tried the touch controls, download today and check it out!

[b]And by the way, that means Assemble With Care is available for everyone - no Apple Arcade subscription required on mobile any longer.[/b]

We hope these changes will mean more people than ever will discover Assemble With Care! If you're a fan of the game but haven't had a chance to play on mobile, check it out, or let your friends know there's a new way to play!

notes.title: Monument Valley dev's antique restoration game Assemble With Care gets free epilogue
notes.notes:
Assemble With Care, the charming 80s-themed bric-a-brac restoration game from Monument Valley developer Ustwo, has just received its first free update, introducing an expansive epilogue to cap its well-received core campaign.

Assemble With Care initially launched as an Apple Arcade exclusive late last year and then made its way to Steam in March; it's a lovely, low-key thing - part illustrated storybook, part puzzle game - that charts the adventures of Maria, a globe-trotting antique restorer, as she helps the residents of the sun-soaked town of Bellariva save their beloved possessions.

The storytelling is pleasant enough, but it's the tactile delights found in restoring an assortment of ageing keepsakes and mementos that really makes the experience shine, whether you're twirling a pencil to re-spool a cassette tape, rewiring the innards of an old gaming handheld, disassembling an old camera, repairing a watch, and more.

notes.title: Time for a coffee break!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36430131/0f1b81fa0e739ad936323b9a0c34489e2b8a4a6a.jpg[/img]
Back when we created a working prototype of the game - the interaction which ended up becoming the cassette deck level - we came up with the problem of choosing which objects would make it to the final game. There were so many cool ideas thrown about: a set of dolls, a skateboard, Scalextric, an orrery etc. But we had to combine cool objects, that had interesting interactions and would make sense in the story. And that's when we created THE COOL BOARD! It had two axes: Cool, and Risky.

One of the winners, that everyone loved and wanted in the game, was too complex. There was no way to fit it into the story in a way that wouldn't break up the pacing and take us too long to finish. So we decided against it. Until now.

We hope you enjoy this new update, it's free of charge so just make sure your game has finished updating and if you finished Assemble with Care you should be able to see it in the level select. From all of us here at ustwo games, we hope you are all doing well and keeping safe. This new level has made us nostalgic of the office and reminded us of how good it was when we were all hanging out and working together. We'll be together again!


Your friends at ustwo games

notes.title: Plug your headphones into your Walkmans, here comes the soundtrack!
notes.notes:
Happy 1 month anniversary everyone! Well, not quite, but close enough. On the 26th of March we released [i]Assemble with Care[/i] on PC and we wanted to say [b]thank you[/b] for your support so far! Our reviews have been very heartwarming to read. Some of you highlighted a few bugs (more on that below). And some others mentioned you really liked the soundtrack!

This leads us to our first update: The soundtrack is now available for [b]free[/b] for anyone who purchases (or already purchased) [i]Assemble with Care[/i] on Steam. What's more, it's also available on major music streaming platforms! All credit goes to Thomas Williams who worked with us on the project as well as composed and recorded all the music in the game and the soundtrack. We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36430131/b156bc5dc5b334da5a7d49ab2edc2cdf65199a5a.jpg[/img]

Second, when we shipped we discovered little bugs remained in the game. Thank you to all of those that pointed them out to us! Most of them are small and most of you wouldn't have seen them or noticed they were a bug. The biggest issue we ran into occurred during the Music Box level and some of you also reported running into softlocks (a situation where you can still play but progress in the game becomes impossible) at that stage. This has now been fixed and the playthrough should be a smooth experience for everyone. If that's not the case, please let us know!

Lastly, we're continuing to work on [i]Assemble with Care[/i]! There was an object we [b]really[/b] wanted in the game but was too big to finish it for release. It will be ready soon and will be included in the base game.

And that's it! It's been a trying time for many of us and we recognise we're luckier than most. Thank you for all the support and kind words during this time and we hope that, at least for a short time, our games made your lives a little brighter!

Your friends at ustwo games

notes.title: Assemble With Care fixes up a spot on PC today
notes.notes:
What’s your self-isolation hobby? Knitting? Woodburning? How about taking up antique restoration with Ustwo Games’ repair ’em up Assemble With Care? Six months after breaking onto Apple Arcade, the Monument Valley developers’ pastel-tinted restoration puzzler arrived on Steam today. After all, who knows more about the satisfying agony of repeatedly re-assembling complex electronics than PC owners?

notes.title: Assemble with Care now live on PC!
notes.notes:
Steam is familiar territory to us as players but finally releasing a game here as developers we feel giddy and excited! In 2017 we released Monument Valley 2 and started prototyping a few different games. Being an eclectic bunch with different tastes and inspirations, we found it hard to define what it was that an “ustwo games game” was and with Assemble with Care, we feel like we found out what connects all of our games. One aspect of that is bringing what we love about videogames to as wide an audience as possible, and what better way to reach millions of people than Steam?

When Assemble with Care released on Apple Arcade we had the challenge of creating a game that worked on mobile devices (iOS), Apple TV and Mac. Making the game work in Portrait and Landscape was not without its difficulties but thanks to our crafty programmers we shipped a version that we felt proud of across all devices. However, we like to take pride in our work and the moment we started creating the port for PC we saw an opportunity to make our landscape version even better so we played around with inputs on mouse and keyboard, graphic settings and making sure the build ran smoothly on a variety of PC builds. We even managed to get to 2,000 FPS on some configurations, we spent so much time thinking if we could that we never stopped to think if we should… Anyway, the end result is a new version of the game that we’re proud of and has much improved since we shipped it last September. We hope you enjoy it and if you do like it, check out our other games!

Nervously excited,
Your friends at ustwo games

notes.title: Monument Valley devs fix up a PC debut for Assemble With Care
notes.notes:
After being robbed of two of the best little puzzlers on mobile, Monument Valley developers Ustwo Games are finally making their PC debut with Assemble With Care. Arriving on Steam later this month, Ustwo’s pastel-painted repair ’em up has you dissecting people’s junk – and their personal problems – before putting it all back together again. In this economy, who can afford to be an engineer without doing a little counselling on the side?
